assessments.technical_explanation: The Execute JS Code node uses new Function to run user-authored JavaScript from the flow's node data. This is a deliberate, disclosed feature of a visual automation tool. The node is marked isDangerous: true, and per the project's README, dangerous nodes are gated behind an explicit Allow Dangerous toggle that the user must enable per flow. The executed code is authored by the user in the visual editor, not received from an external or untrusted source. No concealed execution, exfiltration, or persistence beyond the extension's stated purpose is demonstrated.
assessments.layman_explanation: This extension includes a node that lets you run your own JavaScript code as part of a visual flow. This is an intentional feature, clearly labeled as dangerous, and requires you to explicitly enable it before it can run. It only runs code you write yourself.
